title: Everyday laptop
lesson: Semantic article, Grid layout, spacing and a small stateful enhancement.
check: Add/remove the sample product; resize to 390px.
limits: Sample price. Bag is in memory and resets on reload. Uses an original SVG instead of the archive photo with unverified rights.

title: Tomato toast
lesson: Semantic recipe, native details, responsive Grid and scaled quantities.
check: Choose 4 servings; bread becomes 4 slices and tomatoes 400g. Open method with keyboard.

title: Project navigation
lesson: Navigation landmarks, native anchors, Flexbox and a keyboard-friendly mobile disclosure.
check: At 390px open Menu, choose Build, then reopen and press Escape.

title: Social tooltips
lesson: Positioned tooltip, accessible name and description, focus and Escape behavior.
check: Tab to GH; label is visible. Escape hides it. Focus next button.

title: Button feedback
lesson: Readable native button states instead of glass and low-contrast effects.
check: Click to save and undo. Activate with Enter/Space. Check reduced motion.

title: Loading skeleton
lesson: Loading state, aria-busy, finite skeleton animation and completed state.
check: Click Load; confirm skeleton is replaced after ~1 second.
limits: Intentional local delay, not an API request.

title: Colour studio
lesson: Input events, validated hex values, live style updates and clipboard error fallback.
check: Enter #ff0000, then invalid hex. Colour input and preview stay in sync.

title: Theme preferences
lesson: CSS variables, system preference and safe localStorage persistence.
check: Choose Dark, reload, then choose System. Blocked storage should not crash UI.

title: Character counter
lesson: Unicode-aware code-point count, empty input, progress and over-limit feedback.
check: Type abc (3), then emoji; exceed 140 and clear the field.
limits: Counts code points, not user-perceived grapheme clusters. Does not silently truncate text.

title: Temperature converter
lesson: Pure conversion function, numeric parsing and absolute-zero validation.
check: 0°C ->32°F; 212°F ->100°C; reject -274°C. Empty input is not zero.

title: Pick a practice task
lesson: Split, trim, filter, array indexing and random choice.
check: Pick from 3 choices; blank lines ignored. Reject one or zero options.
limits: Learning randomizer; not for cryptographic use or prize selection.

title: Rate this lesson
lesson: Native radio group with explicit labels, selected state and clear action.
check: Use Tab then arrow keys to change rating; clear selection.
limits: Rating stays local to this visit; nothing is submitted.

title: Find a topic
lesson: Filtering into a native listbox; keyboard support without inventing an incomplete ARIA combobox.
check: Search CSS (2); search zzzz (0); ArrowDown focuses results and selection updates.

title: Learning tabs
lesson: Tab semantics, roving tabindex and one active panel.
check: Click Practice; ArrowLeft, Home and End move focus and panel together.

title: Learning progress
lesson: State boundaries, progress and disabled controls.
check: Previous initially disabled; Next disabled at Review; return to Plan.

title: Choose your track
lesson: Replace an old jQuery custom select with a styled native select.
check: Select Responsive CSS with keyboard; choose placeholder again.

title: Sign-in interface
lesson: Labels, autocomplete, native validation and honest form behavior.
check: Reject invalid email/short password; valid demo input shows no-authentication message.
limits: No backend, authentication, password storage or credential transmission. Password cleared after valid preview.

title: Password visibility
lesson: Input type toggle, pressed state and clear accessible labels.
check: Type a demo string, toggle show/hide, keep value unchanged. No network request.

title: Code input
lesson: Numeric input filtering, paste distribution, focus, backspace and format-only validation.
check: Paste 123456; check format. Reject letters. Backspace from an empty box moves left.
limits: No OTP generation, authentication or server verification.

title: Age calculator
lesson: Local date parsing, valid calendar dates, future rejection and birthday boundaries.
check: Birth date today ->0; birthday tomorrow and yesterday; leap day policy. Reject future date.

title: World clock
lesson: Intl date/time formatting, time zones and deriving display from Date.
check: Switch UTC/India and 24-hour mode. Seconds update and date label follows zone.

title: Focus timer
lesson: Start/pause/reset state and deadline-based countdown.
check: Apply 1 minute, Start, Pause, Resume, Reset; reject 0/121/fractional minutes.
limits: Timer is for a single open page; closing or reloading resets it. No notification or background service.

title: Weather preview
lesson: Weather layout and consistent rendering from an explicitly static dataset.
check: Switch cities; every metric updates from the same sample record.
limits: Static illustrative data, not measured weather.

title: Live weather
lesson: Fetch, geocoding, abort/timeout, validation, loading/error and offline sample states.
check: Load offline sample; search Chennai; try nonsense city; test unavailable network.
limits: Requires internet for live provider response. No secret API key. Non-commercial educational API terms apply. Offline sample is explicitly labelled.

title: Expand the view
lesson: Flex expansion, real button controls and touch/keyboard alternatives to hover.
check: Expand second/third image with click and Enter; compare mobile stacking.

title: Frame by frame
lesson: Single active index, next/previous wrapping and captions.
check: Previous on first ->3; Next on last ->1. Image alt/caption follow the index.

title: Responsive carousel
lesson: Responsive media, optional autoplay, pause on focus/hover and background cleanup.
check: Start autoplay; Pause; focus a control to pause rotation. Check reduced-motion preference.
limits: Autoplay is opt-in and disabled by reduced-motion preference. Uses native state rather than an unnecessary carousel dependency here.

title: Motion timing
lesson: Keyframes, animation duration, play-state and reduced motion.
check: Change speed; pause/resume. Reduced motion produces a static ring.

title: CSS depth
lesson: CSS perspective and transform-style with focus and reduced-motion alternatives.
check: Focus and hover the card; verify content is readable without hover.
limits: The 3D effect is CSS-only; common theme switch uses JavaScript.

title: Two sides of a card
lesson: 3D backface, persistent click trigger and inactive-face accessibility.
check: Flip with Space/Enter. Hidden face is inert and aria-hidden; reduced motion removes travel.

title: Pointer tilt
lesson: Normalized pointer coordinates, bounded transforms and requestAnimationFrame cleanup.
check: Move pointer and leave card; disable tilt. Touch has a stable fallback.

title: Scroll through layers
lesson: Pinned local GSAP/ScrollTrigger, bounded scroll mapping and matchMedia cleanup.
check: Scroll scene; foreground moves within bounds. Reduced motion keeps scene still.
limits: GSAP library integration, not a custom animation engine. Local vendored library retains its license.

title: Zoom on scroll
lesson: ScrollTrigger boundaries, from/to values, overflow crop and refresh behavior.
check: Scroll and resize; image remains inside frame. Reduced motion avoids zoom.

title: Stack your learning
lesson: CSS view-timeline enhancement, sticky fallback, readable DOM order and reduced motion.
check: Scroll all cards at desktop/mobile; all content reachable. Unsupported view timeline remains readable.
original_folder: Scroll-driven animated card stack with scroll snap events

title: Neon pointer lab
lesson: Local ES modules, threejs-toys neonCursor, WebGL capability failure and user control.
check: Start with a fine pointer, move pointer, Stop. Reduced motion/coarse pointer must keep static fallback.
limits: Library has no public dispose API; Stop reloads the lesson to release WebGL/RAF resources. This is documented rather than claiming a fake cleanup method.

title: Scratch to reveal
lesson: HiDPI canvas, local pointer coordinates, capture/cancel and keyboard reveal/reset.
check: Scratch surface, reveal via keyboard, reset, then resize. No real reward.

title: Focus audio
lesson: Media play promises, real playback state, seeking, volume and native controls.
check: Play/Pause; native control sync; seek; volume; restart and ended state.
limits: No autoplay; local generated audio, not a copyrighted commercial song.
original_folder: Simple Music App Ui Design - Nothing4us

title: College code, rebuilt.
lesson: Portfolio with real runnable project links, responsive composition and honest evidence.
check: Open all four linked projects; check mobile reading order.
limits: Uses Waay2tech learning projects as evidence. No invented clients, credentials, testimonials or contact details.

title: Less admin. More teaching.
lesson: Responsive service page, anchor navigation and native accessible dialog.
check: Navigate sections, preview a typed brief, Escape closes dialog and restores focus.
limits: Local brief preview only; no contact form submission, lead storage, pricing promise or actual automation integration.

title: Tools for your desk.
lesson: Integrated product grid, filtering, sorting, computed cart total, dialog and local Swiper integration.
check: Add laptop + notebook -> ₹50,290; remove, filter Stationery, sort by price; navigate featured products.
limits: Sample catalogue and local in-memory cart only; no payment, backend, real inventory or account system.
